record.question: Is this document signed, an unsigned version, or a draft? Judge from the body text, not the title alone. Give its signed date and effective date if stated, and the value of each of these terms it sets.

terms.value: $1,850 USD per seat per year gross, subject to the carried-forward 14% discount in Section 4.2 ($1,591 net per seat per year, calculated).
